skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Describe the current state of economic activities and resource management in organizations/regions.
Evaluate strengths and weaknesses, identify issues in economic activities and resource management.
Apply theoretical knowledge to analyze and explain issues in economic activities and resource management.
Collect relevant information reflecting the results of economic activities and resource management.
Evaluate planning, policies, programs, and projects for economic and social development in resource management.
Propose solutions to problems in economic activities and resource management.
Work independently and effectively in teams to solve assigned tasks.
Analyze, synthesize, and evaluate data to propose solutions to real-world management issues.
Continuously improve professional expertise through self-study and experience accumulation.
Draw conclusions and propose solutions to emerging issues in economic activities and resource management.
Adapt to changes in organizational management and environmental management during practical engagement.
